Item.Description: A transparency slide showing the left rear leg of a carousel pig. It is extremely worn. The tack is red with a brown clasp detail. A very small portion of the saddle blanket can be seen, colored green and red, with a little bit of yellow. The saddle can be seen at the top, colored brown. The skin of the pig ranges from a lighter tan to brown. There are some areas with not paint, that are colored black, the top, the bottom, and the insides of the legs. The pig is standing on the ground with a white backdrop. The slide reads “PULLEN PARK CAROUSEL PULLEN PARK LEFT REAR 16B” at the top and “RALEIGH NC WAKE CO Pig RR RALEIGH FINE ARTS SOCIETY” at the bottom. Up the side is stamped “JUN79”.

Title: Pullen Park Carousel - PPC2019.001.536
